channel.title: Rust Development Updates
channel.description: AI-summarized daily Rust development updates from Facepunch source-control commits.

item.title: Today's Rust Updates — Aug 28
item.description:
70 development commits

✨ NEW — LAST 3 HRS

  • Navmesh now accounts for opening/closing doors without a full rebuild and improves door‑handling performance.
  • Ammunition magazines now drop correctly in third‑person for Abyss AK, Ice AK and Space LR300.
  • Fixed pool ball velocity creep between shots, ensuring proper ball movement.
  • Fixed disconnect flow to prevent duplicate unsubscribe errors, improving network stability when leaving servers.
  • Adjusted head icon rendering so icons now appear in front of the player character.
  • Resolved multiple idle animations playing simultaneously, eliminating jitter and allowing reaction animations to trigger properly.

Construction & Vehicles

  • Fixed boat building to correctly handle non‑zero ocean level, fixing hull placement, boat creation, and deployable height limits.

AI Navigation

  • Navmesh now accounts for opening/closing doors without a full rebuild and improves door‑handling performance.

Combat & Weapons

  • Ammunition magazines now drop correctly in third‑person for Abyss AK, Ice AK and Space LR300.

Pool Mini‑Game

  • Fixed pool ball velocity creep between shots, ensuring proper ball movement.

Weapons UI

  • Added a new Crystal AR page under the Weapons category, exposing crystal AR weapons information to players.

Stability & Connectivity

  • Fixed disconnect flow to prevent duplicate unsubscribe errors, improving network stability when leaving servers.

UI & Animation

  • Corrected draggable UI anchor handling, ensuring UI elements stay positioned correctly when moved.
  • Adjusted head icon rendering so icons now appear in front of the player character.
  • Resolved multiple idle animations playing simultaneously, eliminating jitter and allowing reaction animations to trigger properly.
  • Fixed icon caching in the store menu, ensuring icons refresh correctly after opening via escape or re-entering the store.

item.title: Yesterday's Rust Updates — Aug 27
item.description:
66 development commits

Gameplay & Economy

  • Monument blockers now sync to clients, have a 24‑hour decay period, and are immune to fire damage.
  • Code locks with two or fewer authorized users are ignored in door tax calculations, lowering upkeep costs.
  • HAB armour now transfers damage to its parent hot‑air balloon instead of itself.
  • AR entities spawn with the correct starting ammo.

Building & Infrastructure

  • Boat building stations can deploy when the ocean level setting is non‑zero or negative, supporting custom ocean levels.
  • Unpowered water pumps no longer act as gravity sources.
  • Maintainable prefabs now spawn correctly with relaxed anchor checks, added terrain anchor rings, and dithering with configurable retry logic to reduce pipe and roadside decor placement failures.

Items & Interaction

  • Master key animation no longer sticks on left‑click, ensuring proper swipe behavior.
  • Paintable dialog interactions and brush cursor are disabled while the F1 menu is open.
  • General store UI grids now receive closure notifications, preventing asset bundle reference leaks.

Performance & Network

  • Network update range for critters reduced to improve performance.
  • Client prediction disabled for firecrackers and survey charges to prevent missing‑file errors.

Crafting & Power

  • Industrial crafter machines retain their active state after a power loss, removing the need for manual restart.

item.title: Rust Updates — 2 Days Ago — Aug 26
item.description:
113 development commits

World & Exploration

  • Improved critter movement with correct speed values, smoother animation blending, and no hovering above ground.
  • AI selection commands now affect multiple livestock; offset positions prevent NPC stacking.
  • Scientist corpses placed on ragdoll layer, no longer blocking movement or projectiles.
  • Navmesh gaps behind doors fixed, restoring access to rooms such as missile silo and ghostship.
  • World objects spawn correctly: water pipes no longer appear at odd angles and gas station loot spawners persist after server restarts.
  • Players cannot loot clipping bodies while mounted on submarines; must exit the mount to loot.
  • Player boats now retain their usage timer, preventing decay on daily restart servers, and error messages for invalid placement are clarified.

Combat & Damage

  • Shield mechanics now function correctly during combat.
